facts.description: Our most popular package, the private single-day hiking tours are the perfect way to immerse yourself in the beauty of Joshua Tree National Park. 6 hours You can choose to meet at our office, be picked up locally or request transportation from Coachella Valley cities. Your guide will then take you on a drive through the most incredible parts of the park, on-route to your hike/sightseeing for the day. From your trailhead, your guide will lead you on a mostly off-trail adventure of 1-6 miles, through the Joshua Tree wilderness. Towering rock formations, canyons, sweeping vistas, and surreal landscapes from another planet await you around every bend. Enjoy an optional lunch on the trail before continuing your journey. All along the way, your expert guide will share the history and geology of the Park, along with a myriad of stories and talks about the plants, animals, and other unique characteristics of the Park. You may even get in some epic rock scrambling to the top of some of our famous rock formations for views and experiences rarely had by others. At the conclusion of your hike, time permitting, your guide will get you to some of the other popular sights in the park before returning you safely to our office or back to your lodging facility where you can relax and talk about the memories that you have made, that will last a lifetime. - Pick up and drop off from our office in Joshua Tree - All park fees - Water - Transportation in & around the park - An optional lunch on the trail (additional fees apply) - A loaner daypack. facts.headline: All Ages! • 8 Hours • Up to 7 people!
facts.description: Our private, single-day hiking and climbing tours with a certified guide are the perfect way to immerse yourself in all that Joshua Tree National Park has to offer. 8 hours After meeting at our office, Your guide will then take you on a drive through the most incredible parts of the park. Along the way, you will receive a detailed narration on the park, its history, and interesting geology unique to Joshua Tree. Once at your trailhead, your guide will lead you on a mostly off-trail adventure through the Joshua Tree wilderness. Towering rock formations, canyons, sweeping vistas, and surreal landscapes from another planet await you around every bend. Enjoy an optional lunch on the trail before meeting your rock guides to climb and rappel from our world-famous rock formations. Your climbing experience includes professional instruction from our certified rock guide, and all necessary equipment. Whether you are a first-time climber or multi-pitch expert, our guides will make sure you have an incredible experience. All throughout the day, your personal guides will share the history and geology of the Park, along with a myriad of stories and talks about the plants, animals, and other unique characteristics of the Park. You may even get to add in some epic rock scrambling to the top of some of our otherworldly rock formations, for views and experiences rarely had by others. At the conclusion of your hike and climb, time permitting, your guide will try to get you to some of the other popular sights in the park before returning you safely to our office where you can relax and talk about the memories that you have made, that will last a lifetime. NOTE: Due to the extended time period for this journey, pick-up and drop-off is not available. All hike and climb trips will meet at our office in Joshua Tree. More Info INCLUDES: Guided tour, hiking, climbing, all equipment, private instruction Park fees, Transportation from our office, and Water. Important - Please use adult name for contact information and put child's name in rider field. - Pony rides do not go on the trails, they are lead around the property. - We use our older and calm horses for pony rides. - Minors must have waiver signed by parent/guardian, adults accompanying minors must sign waiver.
